not_findings_and_qualifications: RigJointName deliberately retains empty, unfamiliar, namespaced, whitespace, and exact case; scalar Serde is consistent with that explicit open identity contract. Source test bodies were read, not run.

MHR membership classifies the profile spelling and does not prove a joint is in a receiving rig. Source tests intentionally accept l_ and its r_ proposal; no malformed-name rejection or compatibility defect is inferred.

RigJointPart is the closed fragment vocabulary and contains_part is intentionally a substring query including helper suffixes, not a canonical-anatomy proof. Similar Loleg/Lowleg, Loarm/Lowarm and upperarm/uparm spellings are not merged without authored-asset evidence.

RigJointName::index_in deliberately chooses the first duplicate. RigJointOrdinal represents an ordered position and explicitly does not prove another rig membership; RigJointTable::get is checked and Index requires a previously established ordinal.

LEFT_LEG_CHAIN/RIGHT_LEG_CHAIN express ordered labels, not evidence that a receiving rig has those joints or actual ancestry. RigSide, RigJointPart, RigJointName and RigJointOrdinal represent distinct meanings.

The four scoped product files are byte-identical between 6533 and 95e. This establishes no behavioral regression within those bytes, nor proves whole-repository behavior preservation. Support files such as skin.rs and table.rs changed across revisions.

No handwritten trait replacement is recommended without evidence of equivalent macro semantics, bounds and admission. Membership-to-u32 0/1 is a native encoding, while eq_ignore_ascii_case is a predicate.
